body:
🪄 PmcChatMentions
A lightweight, powerful Paper plugin that adds smart @mentions in chat with customizable colors and sounds, Titles.

📦 How It Works
This plugin listens to player chat and automatically highlights mentioned players in the message.

Player names are converted to colored mentions (e.g., @LUCIFER_XD).
Plays a notification sound when a player is mentioned and shows an configurable title..
Fully configurable via config.yml.
This plugin only handles mentions and chat formatting. It does not alter gameplay.

⚙️ Features
✅ Customizable mention colors

Set your preferred RGB color for mentions (e.g., "&#F2C137") in the config.
🔊 Notification sounds

Choose any Minecraft sound to play when a player is mentioned.
Set pitch and volume directly in the config.
🛑 Toggle mentions per player

Players can enable or disable mentions for themselves using /mention toggle.
📄 Command system

/pmcmention reload – reload plugin config without restarting the server.
/mention toggle enable or disable mentions for yourself.
🎨 Fully compatible with Adventure MiniMessage

All chat formatting supports Adventure MiniMessage syntax, including hex colors.
